note: Phrase patterns for internal process wording that must not be published from this repository. Each allowlist entry names one pattern id, one file glob and the exact matched text (or a regex over it) with a reason; it covers product wording only. A pattern with knownFrom ignores tokens that this repository itself defines. Allowlist regexes are written so that their own text does not match the patterns.
